Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in Houston, Texas, involving a low-speed head-on impact. On
arrival, Driver 1 was standing beside a sedan with the front bumper and hood pushed in, and Driver 2 was seated in a
second vehicle with visible front-end damage. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and
said the impact had jolted the head forward and back. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched Driver 1's account of
how the vehicles came together, and two independent witnesses on the scene described the same sequence.
Photographs taken at the scene show damage that corresponds with the reported point and force of impact, and no
prior damage to either vehicle was noted by anyone present. A Passenger seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was
identified by both witnesses and confirmed being in the car at the time of the crash. Driver 1 was confirmed as a
named driver on the insurance policy covering the sedan. Offciers observed no signs of impairment and recorded the
scene for the file.
